adjudication.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at the diff, the EmbedController#best method (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:14) calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` when no topic_id is found, which is an asynchronous job. However, the test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:42-46 expects `TopicRetriever.new` to be called directly and sets up a mock for it. Since the controller enqueues a job rather than calling TopicRetriever directly, the mock expectation `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` will never be satisfied because the actual TopicRetriever call happens in the job (lib/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb), not in the controller. This is a real test bug - the test doesn't properly verify the asynchronous behavior.
